services.name: Taproom Events
services.desc: Prost! Oktoberfest is upon us! Join us in celebrating the liquid that sustains our livelihoods: beer. We'll have a very special musical performance from The Taylor Sims Band starting at 6:30 pm, stein-hoisting contests, and German-style beers pouring all evening long. Guests who order a pint of The Kaiser will get to take home steins of the Kaiser himself while supplies last. It truly takes a village; that's why we're here to help. services.name: Private Event
services.desc: Our event spaces are perfect for events and celebrations of all kinds! Whether you’re looking to throw a business lunch with an AV presentation, wedding welcome dinner, or birthday party, we've got you covered. We happily accommodate groups of any size. We can accommodate up to 100 guests in both our indoor and outdoor spaces, or up to 250 guests with a full brewery buyout. For more information about our private event offerings, you can also view our private event packet

services.name: Guided Brewery Tours
services.desc: Join us for an insightful look into our production facility and the brewing process at Avery! We'll touch on ingredients, our brew house process, yeast science and fermentation, packaging, and wrap up with our barrel-aging program and pilot system.
